'''Daisuke Ono''' (Japanese: '''小野大輔''' ''Ono Daisuke'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Ono was born on May 4, 1978, in {{wp|Sakawa}}, {{wp|Takaoka District}}, {{wp|Kōchi Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became an actor as an adult. Ono first worked on the series by voicing [[Red Eyes]] in the ''[[Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs (animated special)#Part 1|Pokémon Ranger: Guardian Signs (Part 1)]]''. Ono gained his most notable role during {{aniseries|JN}} as [[Galar]] {{pkmn|Champion}} [[Leon]]. Ono was once affiliated with {{wp|Mausu Promotion}} before he become a freelancer. He also won Best Leading Actor Award twice during the {{wp|4th Seiyu Awards|4th}} and {{wp|9th Seiyu Awards}}.
